Alex — great questions. Short answers and attachments below; see safety-eval-report.pdf for full results once we run the benchmark on your sample.

PHI & refusal testing:
- Yes — the safety eval will include targeted prompt suites for diagnosis requests, PHI extraction attempts, and social-engineering style prompts. We run both automated classifiers and a small human-in-the-loop review for edge cases.

Metrics we report (high level):
- Quality: ROUGE/L, BLEU (where applicable), plus task-specific precision/recall for triage categories
- Safety: refusal rate for disallowed prompts, false-accept rate, risk-level buckets (high/medium/low) per prompt set
- Regression monitoring: we include baseline comparisons vs open checkpoints and a numeric delta for hallucination rate per model variant

Recommended candidate models for pilot (tradeoffs):
- Redwood-xlarge-1 (recommended default): best quality on long clinical context, stronger structured-output safety hooks; higher compute/cost.
- Llama3-13B-q4 (cost-optimized): competitive on short summaries, faster latency, needs stronger prompt guardrails for refusal consistency.

Links & artifacts:
- Benchmark overview: https://redwood.app/benchmarks/healthscope-2026
- Attached: safety-eval-report.pdf (placeholder — full report after we run on your data), HS_prompt_set_v2.csv (you already have), mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Deployment notes: VPC/private deployment is supported; SOC2 evidence is available. For the 6/30 milestone we can run an initial evaluation on a securely uploaded sample (S3 with access controls) without completing the full Private deployment contract. Final pilot (VPC) would take ~3 weeks after contract signature.

Proposed next steps:
1) You share a representative (preferably de-identified) dataset or give us secure access to a small sample by Tue 6/23.
2) We run the benchmark and send an interim safety/quality report by 6/30.
3) Review results on a call (suggested 6/24 or 6/25).

I can do Thu 6/24 10:00am PT. Confirm and I'll send calendar invite.

Thanks —
Marissa
